hints.title: Weighted Median Target
hints.text: The total cost function is convex and achieves its minimum at the weighted median of nums with weights given by cost.

hints.title: Sorted Cumulative Weights
hints.text: Pair each nums[i] with cost[i], sort by nums[i], and compute the prefix sums of weights.

hints.title: Median Element Identification
hints.text: Find the element where the cumulative weight reaches or exceeds half of the total weight sum. Compute cost relative to this target.

hints.title: Weighted Median Cost Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting pairs takes O(n log n), followed by single linear pass to locate weighted median.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all possible target values naively takes O(n * (max_val - min_val)) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Pairs array stores paired values and weights.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes that the optimal point of L1 minimization with weights is the weighted median.
